svg.text: OPTION 2 - GROUND FLOOR (Phase 1): 3 bedrooms, living, dining, kitchen, 3 toilets
Carpet area about 1,000 sqft inside walls. Built-up ground floor 24' to 70' plus 78' to 101'6". Parking under the first-floor slab from 14'.
ROAD / GATE (NORTH) on the left. Top edge = EAST neighbour house (our new 9" wall). Bottom edge = WEST apartment (existing wall). Right = BACK (existing wall).
Plot 106' long, 21' wide at road, 20' at back. Scale drawing. Walls: outer 9", partitions 6". x = feet from front boundary.
NEEM TREE trunk 1'6" at 3'6" from road,
7'6" from west. Leans in to ~8'. Keep slab clear to 14'.
EXTERNAL STAIR 4' wide, 18 risers x 7", tread 10"
Black squares = RCC columns (12" x 9") in the side walls: 6 per side, beams across 19', hall above is column-free
HALL FOOTPRINT ABOVE (first floor, phase 2): 46' x 20'
